summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.73/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.73 a gallon across Wisconsin as of July 22, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 16¢ higher than a week ago, 7¢ higher than a month ago, and 87¢ higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.46) and the highest in Superior ($3.97).
